results.name: Studio loads from static hosting with no backend media service
Invite links generated without any server
Two real remote WebRTC sources connected
Source stats come from getStats (resolution, fps, bitrate)
Both sources visible simultaneously in multiview
Selecting Preview does not change Programme
Cut puts the Preview source on Programme
Programme unchanged after choosing a new Preview
Auto transition runs and completes
Programme is a composition with 2 sources and graphics
Audio from both sources reaches the programme mix
Mute silences a channel
Programme published as an outgoing WebRTC stream
Remote receiver gets composed video and mixed audio
Received video shows the composition background
Received video contains the keyed graphic
Switching appears in the outgoing stream
Fade to black appears in the outgoing stream
Output statistics reported
WHIP output: POST offer, 201 + Location, media connects
WHIP receiver plays the programme
Stopping WHIP sends DELETE and the session ends
A failed source does not affect other sources or outputs
Reload restores saved production settings
Restored sources are shown as not connected

twitch.detail: This browser cannot encode H.264, which Twitch requires.
